entries.text: "We're on a battlefield!\nI'm prepared for this!"
"Calm down, I have to read the enemy!"
"I won't be a burden to Kamille...!"
"Alone I can't win, but\nI'll hold you back!"
"Since I joined AEUG, I've been ready!"
"I won't hand this world to you!"
"I can't afford to lose\nhere...! No matter what!"
"I never thought it\nwould come to this...!"
"Damn you! To think you could\nput up such resistance!!"
"Guh! Next time, we'll get\nserious with our attack, too!"
"Tch... you really intend\nto fight us Moonrace!"
"Seems I didn't even need to come here."
"Ngh... I can't send them into a\npursuit while they're still damaged!"
"Recall the MS units!\nKeep them off this ship!"
"Don't panic! This ship\nwon't sink so easy!"
"Too weak for us. Let the MS handle it!"
"A ball moving like a mobile suit?!"
"The Gundam is going\ndown, no matter what!"
"If the enemy's a Gundam,\nthere'll be no mercy!"
"You mustached fool! I won't let\nyou have your way any longer!"
"The commander of the Royal Guard\ndares to defy us?!"
"Trying to fight us with a fake?"
"Antiques against us?\nYou must not value life!"
"I'll just do what I can now!"
"Earth needs a spear, not a shield!"
"A Zeravire is no match for me!"
"With this, we end the\nwar with Zeravire!"
"Take him down and Earth is saved!"
"Kuu! Our strike will\nsave the world, huh!"
"I can't let this chance slip away!"
"I won't let you have your way!"
"Now you see the gap in our skills?"
"No need for mercy!\nCome at me for real!"
"You think that attack can stop me?"
"I... I won't lose! Not\nto Sandman... or Touga!"
"I'll pay this back! Just you wait!"
"To regain my memories,\nI have to fight!"
"A psycommu system,\nthat is what it is!!"
"I want my memories! I\nneed to know myself!"
"I don't want to be hurt anymore!"
"I said anyone who\ngets in my way dies!!"
"I won't let you have your way!"
"Such things won't work\non the Psycho Gundam!"
"If you care for me,\nbe gentle! Kamille!!"
"I won't lose...! Not even to Kamille!!"
"Kamille! Stop being an\nenemy, and be gentle with me!"
"I won't let you Titans have your way!"
"How many will your ego make unhappy?"
"I won't hand our future to you!"
"I can't be pulled in by that pressure!"
"This feeling... there's no\nmistake. He's the same as me...!"
"At this rate, I can't\nbe any help to Kamille!"
"With this, I can use my power!"
"Ugh! I won't be done in here...!"
"Heh heh heh, die!\nYou Jin Family scum!!"
"So this is God Sigma Eldar wants!"
"Lord Butcher,\nit appears an enemy attack landed."
"Do you really think something\nlike that can beat me?"
"Gwaaah! Why does it come to this!?"
"So that's God Sigma,\nthe one with Trinity Energy!"
"What are you doing?!\nDon't let humans run wild!"
"Intercept them now! Or it'll mean\na scolding from Lord Butcher!"
"Damn it! At this rate,\nthere'll be a scolding from Lord Butcher!"
"You dare face me with that power?"
"What are you doing! Get back, now!!"
"My apologies, I fell for their trick"
"Hyakki's time has come!\nWe'll rule the world!"
"We must defeat these foes\nand take the Getter Line amp!"
"Where are you aiming?!\nAren't you aiming at me?"
"Curse you!\nI won't forget this grudge even in death!"
"I, Burai! The king of the Hyakki!\nUoooooh!"
"Hahaha! No matter what\nattack I take, I won't budge!"
"This is hardly any fun at all."
"Heh heh heh heh... For an\nenemy, you're not bad at all."
"I won't let a wretch like\nyou lay a finger on me!"
"Damage is fine! Let no ally fall!"
"Make ship a wall! Allies fall back!"
"Why would foes care about our plans?"
"Clear the line! We'll cover you too!"
"Flashy one! You want it that bad?"
"I've crossed death far more than you!"
"Hmph, do you intend to bring me down?"
"Screaming over this is\namateur stuff, you know."
"AEUG! I won't let you go further!"
"So he was one step ahead of me...!"
"Tch! I won't be beaten by you!!"
"Nice! But I can do it too!"
"With that skill you\nfight? You mock battle!"
"I won't stand by while you run wild!"
"I fight for what I believe in!"
"No mercy, Marin! Come at me for real!"
"Aim and attack precise...!\nBut I'll top that!"
"Not yet! I still have\nthings I must do!"
"Marin! I'll never forget\nthe humiliation you gave me!"
"Birth or upbringing don't\nmatter in a mech! A fair fight!"
"The old me is dead,\nMarin! You killed him!"
"Like I'd let you have your way!"
"No way Jiron gets all the glory!"
"Go, Hero Machine! Show\nme what you've got!"
"Handling a Walker Machine,\nI've got some confidence!"
"You bastards, I won't let this slide!"
"Give me a break, lady!\nThink about your age!"
"Ugh, I can't stand this old lady!"
"Blume, please. You're\nthe hero mech, so shine!"
"Now I gotta do this\nright or stand out!"
"Ignoring a buddy in trouble\nwould shame the Sand Rat name!"
"Oh! Could this be my big moment?\nHeh heh, sorry about that"
"Ugh! My legs are starting to give out!"
"Idiot! That's why I told\nyou not to get so cocky!"
"Damn, did I shift the wrong gear!?"
"I'm fine! Just get rid of them!"
"Get a grip. All style, no stuff"
"What, all bark? Waste of my worry."
"Blume, you rely too much on specs!"
"Time to show the Sand\nRats' true skill!"
"I'll show you I can\npilot Garia perfectly!"
"Use what you can...\nThat's the Sand Rat motto!"
"Let me teach you to appreciate us!"
"Hey sis, wanna go out with me?"
"Heh heh! How about some of this too!"
"So this is how it ends, huh...!"
"Tch! You bastard, you did it now!"
"I won't be taken down in one blow!"
"Take this out and I'll get a raise!"
"This was supposed to be easy work!"
"No one said these guys were here!"
"Tch! Drew the short straw, did I?!"
"Think I'm just a fall guy, huh?!"
"I've got some tricks of my own!"
"At this rate the frame won't hold!!"
"If I retreat here, I lose face!"
"W-what?! I'm riding\nin a Rand Ship here!"
"Hah! You wanna pick a fight with me?"
"All gun mounts! Shoot\nit down or you're dead!"
"W-What?! We're on a\nRand Ship, you know!"
"Defying me... you must be a fool!"
"To appear before me...\nCurse your own folly!"
"Hey, what are you doing! Get back now!"
"W-What is this! Am I\nbeing pushed back?!"
"I am king of space!\nI can't be beaten!"
"You think that can take me down?!"
"You dare defy me? I'll\nmake you regret it!"
"Memory of you\nwill vanish this very instant!"
"Feel the power of the RX3 I designed!"
"No anger, no sadness!\nThe sun is all I need!!"
"Beck the Great RX3! Power at maximum!!"
"A supreme, most wicked\nblow! Try this on for size!!"
"I'm a cut above the likes of you!"
"Don't think this is the\nsame as my old machine!"
"How pathetic!\nSo much for Paradigm's top negotiator!"
"Heh! This ain't like you\nlot, all brute force!"
"I can't take that brute force head-on!"
"Useless, useless! Give\nup on attacks like that!"
"Too soft, too soft!\nReal soft attack, man!"
"The names Great and RX\naren't just for show!"
"This toughness!\nCombining three machines really paid off!"
"What's wrong, you crow bastard!\nSeems your usual groove is off!"
"Heh! You're just a negotiator\nwho relies on nothing but talk!"
"The name Super Robot fits\nMY machine far better!"
"Of course not! This\nis MY robot after all!"
"Well, now you see the gap in skill"
"Not yet! You think\nthis can take down RX3?"
"Strike a pose for this?\nThat's not cool at all...!"
"You're not catching me\ntwice, let alone three times!"
"Snap out of it, Dove!\nWe're fine! I think..."
"What the hell!? What's going on here!?"
"No way I'm goin' back to the slammer!"
"What the heck! My robot's in pieces!"
"Close one, my muttonchops...\nNo wait, they're fine!"
"Megadeus...! Just how\nmuch power does it have!"
"Damn it! You slackers, get to work!"
"Damn it all! Get ready to run, now!"
"I know that! Just keep\nyour eyes forward!"
"Beck the Great RX3! H-here to serve!"
"You crow bastard! This\nis the end for you!"
"The true dandy isn't you!\nIt's yours truly!"
"Come on, come on! Quit acting so cool!"
"The sight of that creep in black\nmakes me sick!"
"I hate black, but I\nhate white even more!"
"Nice! That body looks so tough,\nI want to tear it to pieces!"
"You hicks, go back to\nthe wilds or Siberia!"
"I hate black, but I love gold!"
"Nice, you guys! I'll add\nyou to my collection!"
"Watch closely, you\nbrats! This is my youth!"
"What the hell are you\ndoing! Go get the ammo, now!"
"Time for me to shine for once!"
"I won't let Gainer have all the glory!"
"Even a Panther Gun\nhits if aimed right!"
"I'm not nice enough to let you go!"
"Think I'll just take that? No way!"
"Fine by me! This time it's my turn!"
"This is the role assigned to me!"
"Sara can't do it\nalone! I'm coming too!"
"Teacher! Put it on my report card!"
"Because I'm giving it\nmy all, Gainer can too!"
"I won't let my classmates\nend up in danger!"
"Just keep firing to pin them down!"
"Whoa, maybe I pushed\nthe engine too hard..."
"I'm not slacking off!\nIt's just out of reach, okay?!"
"Close one! Lost 2 seconds of my life!"
"Overman or not, it can't hit me!"
"Ha! You dare mess with\nBello...? ...Ow, it bit me!"
"Attacks like that won't\nbreak my Yapan spirit!"
"Damn it, Gainer! So\nwe're really doing this!"
"That damage is gonna be a pain...!"
"Saint Reagan's a real pain in the ass!"
"Ghh! So the legends\naren't just for show, huh!"
"You idiot! We were allies!\nShow a little restraint!"
"No way! What the hell\nam I supposed to do?!"
"Even he's gotta have\nsome kind of weak point!"
"No good! Even I can't take on Gainer!"
"I-I knew it, against\nthese guys I'm useless!"
"Hired by Sibe Rail, it's all over!"
"No work? I'll hire you in Yapan's sky!"
"If this is the end, I'll go all out!"
"Maybe no matter what\nit's all for nothing!"
"Even a legendary beast won't scare me!"
"Gainer! What the hell are you doing?!"
"When they know you,\nit's hard to fight...!"
"Damn... We were allies.\nNow we gotta fight?!"
"Let's set off a big fireworks show!"
"You should know better\nwith gear like this!"
"I won't let this go your way!"
"Just in case! Check the damaged areas!"
"Rally the ship! Next wave is coming!"
"I'm near my limit...! Then I'll\ntake him down with my machine...!"
"Ngh! I won't just\ntake this lying down!"
"Out of ammo...! What\nwas the gunner doing!"
"Stay by the Argama! Fire our guns too!"
"Katz, that's enough!\nLeave it to us now!"
"I Field, huh. Hold out for a bit...!"
"Report status! Even small\ndamage could be fatal!"
"Small ones are swarming\nus! Shoot them down!"
"They're in a gap! Take them down now!"
"Not bad...! This\ncould drag into a war!"
"Direct hit?! Right the\nship! Don't take another!"
"Seal off the damaged blocks! Move it!!"
"Gah! Not yet... She can't sink yet!"
"Titans, you're mine!\nI'll take you on head-on!"
"Against a Titans ship,\nno easy fight, huh!"
"Damn, not good! The ship won't hold!"
"Ngh! Don't let them\npush us any further!!"
"Ngh, not yet! Don't go down yet!!"
"I've got pride too! Watch me do it!"
"With captain gone, if not me, who?"
"Emaan is a novice in\ncombat. I'll crush him flat!"
"Not for the nation, kill\nAnomaly for the dead!"
"Traitor! I won't rest\ntill you're in hell!"
"Would I fall to a\ncrawler on the ground!"
"Fooled by a mere show of force?"
"Can't let you flee!\nI'll bring you down!"
"Now it's my turn to hit you!"
"No mercy for those who get in my way!"
"Ha ha, Lady Luck smiles on me!"
"Against the attacks of\nthose who abandoned Chiram!"
"Think that attack will work on me...!"
"Are they... playing around?\nOr are they just weak?"
"Soft... This will be an easy fight"
"Guh! He seems to be a veteran!"
"Tch! I must rethink my estimate\nof the enemy's strength...!"
"Ngh...! At least my Chiram\nsoldier's spirit stays true!!"
"Damn! No retreat order...\nso we fight to the end!"
"Gah! I can't fail any more than this!"
"Not yet...! Not until I avenge him!"
"Don't defy me! Do you want to die!?"
"If I strike now, at this moment!"
"Even I can pull off\nsomething like this!"
"What a sorry woman I am...\nFlying worse than a cadet...!"
"Why can't I do more than this, why!?"
"Is-Is this really the\npower of a Gundam!?"
"Hit!? How bad!? Will the\nnext one strike home!?"
"How disgraceful! Hit\nby an attack like that!"
"I'll show you I can\nfight even with a Gundam!"
"It hit, but that's\nnothing to worry about!"
"Old man, are you holding back on me?!"
"With power like that,\ndon't call yourself Gundam!"
"A white mobile suit,\nbut still just a fossil!"
"Out of range... Like a real clown!"
"Gundam, if you truly mean\nto resist us to the end!"
"Lieutenant Harry, I'll\nleave the rest to you!"
"Woman! Do not speak in\nDianna Soreil's name!"
"I'll take you down! ...Man,\nthat line was smooth."
"A good kid, huh. But\nI ain't no softie!"
"Let me say this... You're done here!"
"Here we go! You've got no escape now!"
"Time to repay you for all the trouble!"
"Kid Hola, brought so low... so\nshamefully... by those rookies..."
"Damn, I hate to say\nit... Time to retreat!"
"Wait! I'll let you have this one!"
"If I retreat now, my pride is ruined!"
"Stop! I don't want to kill Elchi!"
"Not so easy! I'll\nsurvive to the end, ace!"
"Guh! Fine, I'll call\nit a draw with you!"
"Treat her like a girl,\nshe gets cocky...!"
"M-miss... you'd go that far for me...!"
"Hahaha!\nGo home and suck your mama's tit!"
"Fight me with arms like\nthat? You're a joke!"
"You're ten years too\nearly to be the star!"
"If you're a woman, be\na little more docile!"
"Don't think I'm the same as Promeus."
"Don't think I'm The same as before!"
"Against a woman, I\nguess I can go easy!"
"Outta gas?! At least fit this junker\nwith a reserve tank!"
"What range! No one said they had that!"
"Got it! Leave that guy to me!"
"Who cares about ammo? Let it rip!"
"What a mess of a way to\nfight! You're insane!"
"Miss, all you have to\ndo is become my wife!"
"It's not too late! Be my wife!"
"Shut up! No mercy for you, you two!"
"I'll beat you and be the hero today!"
"Whoa!\nTh-this isn't enough to take me down!"
"You think you can take me on with\nskills like that? What a laugh."
"At this rate, can't hit a fly!"
"Walker Machine squad, total\nattack! All guns fire!"
"All fire on the green Walker Machine!"
"Enemy! Fire! Keep them back!\n...That it? Any orders?"
"Sure, sure. Let me rest a bit"
"Your role is done. Now die cleanly"
"Tch, what a pain! Protecting\nmen is my job too?"
"When am I going to be\na real captain, anyway!"
"Damn! Move the Walker Machines!\nCan't let this drag on!"
"Geraba! I told you, I'm the captain!"
"I told you! My ship's the latest!"
"Engines on! Aim cannons ahead!\nFire two shots each, go!"
"Damn you! Mocking me! Here I come!"
"Jun, your hero has\ncome to lend a hand!"
"KABUTO! I won't let\nyou hog all the glory!"
"Love, love, Sayaka-chan I\nlove you so! Mwah mwah mwah"
"Star, headliner, hero,\nthe main act is here!"
"Heh heh heh. Tetsuya, I\nain't dead weight now!"
"Gyagh, gyagh, gyagh!\n...Huh? No damage at all"
"Serves you right, not a care\nin the world Nya nya nya!"
"What's this! All talk and no action!"
"Oh, not bad at all! You bastard!"
"You bastard, getting\ncocky! You you you you!"
"Damn! I can't hold out like this!"
"Aaaagh! Oh man, give me a break!"
"Hey, get the Great Booster out for me!"
"Hate to part... but Great\nBooster, firing! Bweee!"
"Whoa there! Come and\nget it! Right this way!"
"Eek! Almost wet myself...\nOh, I'm all damp..."
"Heh! That attack won't take me down!"
"Gyaah! T-This can't be good for me!"
"Shut up! No time for that now!"
"H-Hey, Nuke! Move it! I\ncan't see a thing in front!"
"Ugh, aah! W-what do\nI do, what do I do!?"
"Damn you! Think I'll\ngo down that easily!?"
"Shut up! Cut the noise!\nStop yapping in my ear!"
"What do we do, Boss!?\nWe're gonna get creamed!?"
"Ask me that suddenly and even\nthis genius has no good idea!"
"Nuke, Mucha! If we're going\ndown, take that bastard with us!"
"Ah, it's all over... What\nnow...? ...Time to bail!"
"Shut up! Not like I did it for fun!"
"Anyone messing with Maria,\nThis Boss won't allow it!"
"Maria, hun~ I'm on my way over, yeah~"
"I won't be taken down by a mob!"
"Can someone bound by rules beat me?"
"Making it look like Nirvash!\nWhat terrible taste!"
"You bastard! What the\nhell are you up to now!?"
"Dewey! I won't let\nyou wreck the world!"
"If they attack humans,\nI've got no choice!"
"I gotta fight! No matter who it is!"
"I've been wanting to punch\nthat smug face of yours!"
"Fun! This is the chaos of a mad world!"
"Ace himself shows\nup? I'll take you on!"
"Can that bulk keep up\nwith an LFO's moves?"
"Go, dimwit! Get dizzy on my Ref!"
"Follow me! I'll show\nyou a killer trick!"
"Allied with Dewey makes you my enemy!"
"Fate is something you carve\nout with your own hands!"
"I won't bow to fate! That's\nwhat those kids taught me!"
"If you're so hot for war,\nI'll be your opponent!"
"You vixen! Apologize to those\nyou used in the next world!"
"Renton's future won't be\nsacrificed to your ambition!"
"The Edel! Eureka is no\ntool for your ambition!"
"This world isn't yours!\nIt belongs to each of us!!"
"That's for gunning at me! Take it!"
"Nice work, Renton! Leave it to me!"
"What are you doing!\nCalm down and watch!"
"This calls for one at a time!"
"You dare face me? A century too early!"
"A lame attack like that won't hit me!"
"I ain't a wanted man for nothing!"
"Black KLF! You plan to block us?"
"Looks like you can't see me, Charles!"
"Charles! Don't think\nyou can gauge me now!"
"What's wrong, Ray! Old\nhabits show in your moves!"
"In the sky, no one can match me!"
"Can you keep up? With my skills!"
"From below, You can't hit me, no way!"
"Don't think this is just an LFO!"
"What a load...! But I'll endure it...!"
"Just like your head, Dewey!\nIt's spinning out of control!"
"Sorry, but I can't afford to lose!"
"This is the Cutback\nDrop Turn! Remember it!"
"Man! Don't do boring crap like that!"
"Damn, I took a hit like that!"
"I ain't got time For\nyour kiddie games!"
"What's wrong, black KLF! At\nthis rate, your board will cry!"
"Every bit counts. Can't\nlet my guard down...!"
"You've got good eyes...!\nLanding one on me!"
"Even dust piles up... or however it goes.\nCan't get careless against Coralians!"
"I can't track him...!\nMe of all people...!?"
"Can't do jack without\nnumbers! Don't get cocky!"
"Charles! This old bond\nsure is a pain sometimes!"
"As expected, Ray! But\nyou won't get past me!"
"Fun...! Making me serious in the sky!"
"Tch! You even caught\non to my tricks, huh!"
"We fight with our lives!\nThis damage is nothing!"
"Everything you do, you're\na real laugh riot, Dewey!!"
"Guh! That Dewey bastard,\nbuilt one hell of a ship!"
"Tch! I had a bad feeling,\nbut not this bad...!"
"Damn! Even puking blood, I'll do it!"
"Fine by me! My life, come\nand take it if you can!!"
"Is he really stronger than\nme...!? I won't accept that!"
"Leader down, crew done\nfor...! Not a chance!"
"Gekkostate beaten by the\nmilitary? That's a disgrace!"
"You won't get your\nway! Not even if I die!"
"This speed, on par with\nNirvash...! No, even faster...!?"
"Damn! That Charles, he got me good!!"
"Not yet, Charles! This\nfight's not over yet!!"
"Guh! So this is a woman's spite...!"
"Fine by me! You or me, who\nlasts in the sky? Let's go!"
"Don't underestimate me! The\nsky champ's seat is mine!"
"Damn! Now I know how a\nhunted Skyfish feels!"
"Bastard! Even a top sniper\ncan't pull this off!"
"Guh! I can't lose until\nI've stopped you!!"
"Damn! I won't go down to you!!"
"Tch! Guess I'm past my prime now!"
"This is how we do\nit, Gekkostate style!"
"I said I'd do it, so I'll win!"
"Sorry, but this is\nthe only way I know!"
"I'm gonna get a bit forceful here!"
"I gotta do everything I\ncan, that's how it is!"
"I'll do all I can...!\nThat's all there is!"
"No time to cling to\nlife...! Let's go!!"
"Matthieu! Hilda! Get in sync with me!"
"If I down you, maybe a reward!"
"I can't afford to lose to Lieea!"
"Get in my way, and you're done!"
"Lieea, leave the rest to big sis!"
"Hey Lieea, don't push this on me!"
"Scary as an enemy,\nbut great as an ally!"
"Kei's a hero but he's so clueless!"
"I won't let you have our factory!"
"Heh I'll do it at the same price!"
"Ugh, I'm done being chased by Chiram!"
"Heh heh, no way I'm getting\nhit by some Chiram attack!"
"Nyah! I'm flying up here, you know!"
"Ufufu! I've got things like this too!"
"It hit? I had a bad feeling..."
"Now I can't sleep from\nstress! It's bad for my skin!"
"We're comrades, so\njust let me slip away!"
"What!? A Morarbar caught in the air!"
"What do we do, Chief!\nAt this rate we're done!"
"Pros sure are fast!\nGotta get out soon!"
"Ugh! Home base is\nreally out to kill us?!"
"Aah! Both mobility and\nspeed are above Moraba's?!"
"Kyaa! At this rate,\nI'm really done for!"
"No, no way! I'm at my limit!!"
"No, I don't wanna die\nattacked by Chiram!"
"I curse you! Sorry, Chief, but\nI'll curse the Tobe family!"
"If I lose in speed,\nI can't shake them!!"
"No good! I'm gonna get shot down!"
"I'll defeat you and\nwin peace for everyone!"
"I won't let you have\nthis world your way!"
"In a twin tag match, I won't lose!"
"I won't lose to some evil twins!"
"For the factory's\nsurvival... I have no choice!"
"I can't let you deal with Jerid!"
"This is what happens\nwhen you get too close!"
"Can't let this slide! Must stop it!"
"Don't think I'll always cover for you!"
"I won't let you have it your way!"
"That's who beat Jerid? Not so tough"
"Such a beam won't work on me!"
"Seems it did not manage\nto pierce my armor."
"The pilot's skill exceeded my\nexpectations... is that it...?"
"Gah! I can't afford to go\ndown in a place like this!"
"If I don't do this right\nHoney will scold me!"
"No way. Then the\nshutter won't look good."
"Too bad! I've got a\nrefrain right here!"
"Scary look! But no time to fear!"
"Big ship or not, I'll take you on!"
"Galaxy or gold coins,\nI'll knock you down!"
"Close in, Matthieu! Show\nthis fight to the world!"
"Go! My camera will capture the truth!!"
"Picking a fight with\nus... Know your limits!"
"Yeah! My camera will record\nhow the military does things!"
"Coralian or not, we have to fight now!"
"Damn it all! No mercy for you!"
"All I can do is snap the shutter...!"
"Get in my way, I'll take you out!"
"My attack comes first, so\ntake it before you leave!"
"I can't leave you alone,\nwho knows what you'd do!"
"Now that I'm here, you're safe, honey!"
"My target is that one. Roger that!"
"At this range, not\neven in the finder..."
"Hey, Stoner! Where did the enemy go!?"
"I'm feeling it! I'm at my peak!"
"That's what you get for\nletting your guard down."
"So fast! Can't believe I dodged that!!"
"Focus on the camera! For our world!"
"How's that? In the sky, LFOs rule!"
"From below, you can't hit an LFO!"
"Hard to see from down\nhere, but they're panicking"
"What's that? A joke? You kidding me?"
"Can't even dodge that...\nYou're a disgrace to Border!"
"That's supposed to be\nmy line, as the pilot..."
"Whoa, whoa! Since when is war a game?!"
"This guy... Is he\nactually in sync with me?"
"You kidding?! An LFO\nshot down in the sky?"
"Oh! Nice shot from\nground! I'll praise you!"
